title: Mile Square Mayhem
blurb: Cel-shaded action RPG in Hoboken: punch grumps into cheering up, and hold JUMP to fly hanging from a little pink imp. Toy Hoboken, or the real city from Google's 3D tiles.
controls: Stick/WASD move · JUMP/Space (twice = flip, hold in the air = imp glide) · POW/J punch combo (in the air = slam) · IMP/K bite · ⚡/Shift run · drag to look
